recovery.format: OpenPGP armored symmetric encryption, AES256, SHA256 iterated salted S2K; plaintext is Sparkle base64 32-byte seed

passphraseLocation.label: Guzi Assistant Sparkle recovery passphrase (production v1)

instructions: Keep the encrypted backup and its decryption passphrase separately. Copy the passphrase to an independent password manager or offline storage before relying on recovery after loss of this Mac.
Obtain the passphrase through Keychain Access. Do not send it through chat, commit it, or put it in build logs.
Use umask 077 and gpg --output /secure/temporary/private-key --decrypt guzi-assistant-sparkle-production-v1.asc; enter the passphrase interactively.
Restore with Sparkle generate_keys --account cn.shilong.gooz.sparkle.production.v1 -f /secure/temporary/private-key, then use -p and compare with scripts/sparkle-public-key.txt.
Remove the temporary plaintext private-key export after restoration. Retain this identity for later versions.
